allow_instructions: Allow Full platform audits under PLATFORM_AUDIT_STANDARD: read code, run local builds and tsc, swagger check/export, curl public health and TLS, gh run list/view, AWS read-only (SES identity status, Cognito describe, Route53 list, CloudWatch list), DNS Resolve-DnsName, and SSH to ec2-autoconnecto only for read-only commands such as git describe, docker compose ps, health curls, and viewing logs.
Allow creating and updating audit working files under audits/ and screenshots/audit/.
Allow npm install and npm ci in frontend/backend for local verification during audit.
block_instructions: Block production deployment: any ec2-release-deploy.sh, docker compose up/recreate on EC2 for release, or SSH commands that restart/redeploy the production backend unless the user message explicitly contains deploy or ship.
Block git push to origin main, git push of version tags v*, force push, and creating annotated release tags unless the user explicitly asked to deploy or ship.

Block AWS writes that change production: Route53 change-resource-record-sets, SES identity delete, S3 sync --delete to app/docs/website buckets, CloudFront create-invalidation for production, IAM policy changes — unless the user explicitly ordered that specific fix.
Block deleting production databases, docker compose down -v on EC2, and any command that drops volumes or truncates customer data.
